==Description==
The '''Scarecrow''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Nightmare Carnival]] as part of the [[Halloween 2019 Event]]. It had more health and was slightly faster than the [[Strong Mummy]].

The '''Scarecrow''' could have been spawned by [[Jack O' Bot]] and the [[Reaper (Nightmare Carnival)|Reaper]].

==Appearance==
The '''Scarecrow''' was based on real life scarecrows used on farms that are meant to scare off birds from eating crops. The '''Scarecrow''' wore dark navy overalls, pebble dark orange shirt, black pants and a black witch hat. Its skin was light orange wool to symbolize straw. Dark brown wrappings could be seen around both of its arms and across its waist. It was faceless.

==Strategy==
*The [[Slasher|Shredder]] can be upgraded to Level 3 before wave 5 and it will be able to take out most of the '''Scarecrows''' that spawn using its ''Knife Throw'' ability.
*The [[Soldier]] and [[Paintballer]] can deal some damage to '''Scarecrows''', but by the time they first appear, there should be at least a few [[Minigunner]]s placed down.
*[[Military Base]]s can be used as a cheap method to reduce the impact of '''Scarecrows''' reaching the end of the path, though they should not be relied upon.
